name: Tomographic Baggage Surgery V3 · Difficulty 5 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Inspect the numbered transverse slices to reveal each concealed aperture; acquired tracks remain visible. Waiting preserves the current geometry; each deliberate probe control advances one fixed simulation step. Guide the probe through moving baggage apertures, grip the pink backmost relic, then guide it out cleanly. Contact with a solid, an empty grip, exhausted time, or a rejected sealed report: the first failure ends the episode. Dashed trails show the next 1.2 seconds. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; the terminal, shell, Python, address bar, URL or query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
